name: Infiltrator Squad
equipped_with: Every model is equipped with: Bolt carbine; Bolt pistol; Combat knife; Frag grenades; Krak grenades; Smoke grenades.
abilities: Infiltrator, Move through cover, They Shall Know No Fear

Helix Adept: Once per battle round, the damage of a wound against the model or attached unit May be reduced by 1. The ability must be declared after armor and ward saves. Does not work against weapons with a strength of 8 or above.

Haywire mine: Once per battle, this unit may place an Haywire mine while moving. This must be placed within 1" of the unit and more than 3" away from enemy units. The first enemy unit that come within 3" of the Haywire mine suffers 1D3+1 wounds with Strength: 4, AP: -4, D: 1. Vehicles suffer 1D3 glancing hits.

Smoke grenades: The unit may use its Smoke grenades once per game:
- During normal activation.
- If it has not yet carried out its order this round and is targeted by an enemy unit.
The unit gains the "Deflect" ability until the start of its next activation.

Omni scrambler: Equipment such as icons or homing beacons do not function within 6" of the model. Additionally, units arriving via deepstrike that land within 12" roll 4D6 instead of 2D6 for scattering.
